Role.name: PPMF - Admin
Role.Description: Grants full access to all Power Platform Monitoring Framework tables including Alert Route configuration. Assign to Power Platform administrators and solution owners responsible for framework setup and ongoing configuration.
Role.SummaryOfCoreTablePermissions: Full Create/Read/Write/Delete/Append/Append To/Assign/Share at Organization level on ppmf_ErrorEvent, ppmf_ErrorNote, and ppmf_AlertRoute.

Role.name: PPMF - Reader
Role.Description: Grants read-only access to all Power Platform Monitoring Framework tables. Assign to stakeholders and auditors who need visibility into error events without the ability to modify records.
Role.SummaryOfCoreTablePermissions: Read-only access to ppmf_ErrorEvent (Org), ppmf_ErrorNote (Org), and ppmf_AlertRoute (Org). No create, write, or delete privileges on any PPMF table.

Role.name: PPMF - Service Account
Role.Description: Grants minimal privileges for the Power Automate service principal that writes error records and reads alert routing rules. Assign only to the application user created for the PPMF flows. Do not assign to human users.
Role.SummaryOfCoreTablePermissions: ppmf_ErrorEvent: Create/Read (Org), Append To (Org). ppmf_ErrorNote: Create (Org), Append (Org). ppmf_AlertRoute: Read (Org) only. Minimum privileges for flow service principal. Do not assign to human users.

Role.name: PPMF - Triager
Role.Description: Grants read and write access to Error Events and Error Notes for active triage work. Assign to support analysts and developers responsible for investigating, updating, and resolving errors. Cannot modify Alert Routes.
Role.SummaryOfCoreTablePermissions: ppmf_ErrorEvent: Read/Write (Org), Append To (Org). ppmf_ErrorNote: Create/Read/Write/Delete/Append (User), Read (Org). ppmf_AlertRoute: Read (Org) only. No create, write, or delete on Alert Routes.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_base
WebResource.Description: Foundation script for PPMF. Establishes the PPMF namespace and PPMF.utils shared helper module (setSectionVisible, getOptionSetValue). Must be registered as the first library on any form that uses other PPMF scripts.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_releasenotes
WebResource.Description: Release notes for the Power Platform Monitoring Framework. Lists all changes, new features, and fixes for each version.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_config_setup
WebResource.Description:
Post-import setup and configuration page for the Power Platform Monitoring Framework (PPMF).
Provides a guided checklist that validates all required post-import steps: environment variable configuration, connection reference assignments, child flow activation status, and alert route coverage.
Allows administrators to configure environment variables directly from this page without navigating to the solution editor: Environment Name, Portal Base URL (with Commercial / GCC High / DoD presets), Error Retention period, default Teams Group ID, default Teams Channel ID, and alert throttle window.
Supports full CRUD management of ppmf_AlertRoute records, enabling solution-specific alert routing to dedicated Teams channels with per-route severity thresholds.
Requires System Customizer or System Administrator role. Must be accessed from within the Power Platform Monitoring Framework solution as a Configuration Page. The ppmf_AlertRoute table must be provisioned via New-PPMFTables.ps1 before alert route management is available.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_severityBadgeForm
WebResource.Description: Renders a colored badge on the ppmf_severity field in the Error Event form. Replaces the native dropdown display with a styled pill on load and on change.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_connectionrefs
WebResource.Description: Connection Reference Review — View all connection references across the environment with assignment status, connector type, associated cloud flows, record owner, solution membership, and connection ID. Supports filtering by status, connector, solution, and owner.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_errorEventForm
WebResource.Description: Error Event main form controller. Extends the PPMF namespace with PPMF.ErrorEvent (form logic). Hides the Flow section for PowerApp errors and hides the User section for Flow/ChildFlow errors based on ppmf_sourcetype. Depends on ppmf_base.

WebResource.Name: ppmf_severityIcon
WebResource.Description: ppmf_severityIcon script to set the statis indicator for severity on the error event view

Description.description: Centralized triage and configuration console for the Power Platform Monitoring Framework. Provides structured views for reviewing, assigning, and resolving flow and application error events captured across the environment. Includes alert route configuration for directing notifications to solution-specific Teams channels.

connectionreference.description: Provides the Dataverse connection used by PPMF flows to write error event records directly to the ppmf_ErrorEvent table. Required for the Child-Flow Write to Intake List flow. Assign a connection authenticated with an account that has the PPMF - Service Account security role in this environment.

Provides the SharePoint connection used by PPMF flows to write error event records to the PPMF Error Events SharePoint list and to sync items to Dataverse. Required when Writing Mode is SharePoint or Both. Assign a connection authenticated with an account that has Contribute access to the SharePoint site specified by ppmf_SharePointSiteUrl.

Provides the Microsoft Teams connection used by the PPMF alerting flows to post formatted error alert messages to the configured Teams channel. Required for the Child-FlowErrorHandler flows. Assign a connection authenticated with an account that is a member of the target Teams team and has permission to post in the alert channel.
